description: Li ion diffusion coefficient D(T), activation energy Ea, and Nernst-Einstein conductivity σ from AIMD-MLIP at multiple temperatures.

method_notes.aimd_mlip: Born-Oppenheimer MD with foundation MLIP (UMA-s-1p1, task=omat) on DFT-relaxed V0 structure. Langevin NVT thermostat, 2 fs timestep, equilibrate 10 ps + production 100 ps per T. Trajectory saved every 100 fs.
method_notes.msd_fit: Linear regression MSD = 6 D t in the diffusive regime (2-50 ps).
method_notes.arrhenius: ln(D) = ln(D0) - Ea/(kB T) fit across all measured T.
method_notes.nernst_einstein: σ_NE = n_Li z² e² D / (kB T), assuming Haven ratio H_R = 1 (uncorrelated motion). Real σ is typically σ_NE × H_R^-1 with H_R ≈ 0.3-0.7 for SE.
method_notes.caveats: Foundation MLIP (UMA-s-1p1) tends to overestimate Li transport by 3-5× vs experiment for LPSCl family. Ea is more robust than absolute σ. 300 K extrapolation from 600-1000 K Arrhenius has additional uncertainty if non-Arrhenius behavior exists near room T (rare for LPSCl).

results.method: UMA-s-1p1 (task=omat) AIMD, Langevin NVT 600/800/1000 K, 100 ps prod each

diffusion_per_T._note: Cl/P/S diffusion ~ 5x lower than Li → framework immobile, Li-only conductor ✓

arrhenius_fit.sigma_NE_300K_Scm_estimate: ~14e-3 (= 14 mS/cm) using n_Li ≈ 2.22e22 cm⁻³ from V0

vs_experiment.sigma_overestimate_attribution: Foundation MLIP overshoot of transport (typical) + Haven ratio = 1 assumption (real H_R ≈ 0.3-0.7 reduces σ by ~2×)

Roughly EQUAL contributions, both positive (lit consistent direction).

mechanism_interpretation_v2_2026_06_11.dual_mechanism: Cl-rich LPSCl1.6 is faster than ordered LPSCl due to BOTH lower per-hop barrier (Schlem disorder effect, Minafra/Kraft narrative) AND larger prefactor (vacancy carrier density). Both effects in same direction, both literature-supported. Roughly equal contributions to ~3x σ enhancement.
mechanism_interpretation_v2_2026_06_11.paper_message: σ(LPSCl1.6) > σ(LPSCl) is NOT 'prefactor only' (our earlier 5fu-based reading) NOR 'barrier only' (Minafra simplification). It's BOTH — Cl-rich/vacancy structure simultaneously flattens the Li hopping landscape (Ea↓ via 4d-Cl AS distorting cage) AND increases mobile carrier concentration (vacancy + Cl-substituted sites).
mechanism_interpretation_v2_2026_06_11.5fu_to_4fu_correction_2026_06_11: Earlier comp1 5fu Ea=0.172 was an artifact of artificial 5 f.u. cubic supercell (natural F-43m is 4 f.u.). 4fu natural rerun gives Ea=0.2532 (matches Schlem 2020 LPSCl exactly). modelc 5fu Ea=0.224 unchanged (rhombohedral 5fu is natural). Paper #1 narrative thus reversed from 'prefactor dominant, barrier counter-direction' to 'barrier + prefactor both contribute in literature direction'.
mechanism_interpretation_v2_2026_06_11.RT_caveat: 3-point Arrhenius extrapolation to 300K still uncertain; quote 600-1000K values.

Confirms disorder REDUCES the apparent barrier from a frozen/artifactual high value to the experimental value.
